messages:
marta (sales): FYI NorthStar Health wants a 2-week POC. Requirements: EU-only primary traffic, DR failover to us-west only, BYO-KMS, list of EU subprocessors, and an egress cost ballpark. Start Tue next week.

raj (solutions): Got it. Can hosted tier meet strict tenant pinning + BYO-KMS?

kevin (infra): Hosted = soft affinity only. For strict pin + full BYO-KMS isolation you need Dedicated or Private. Hosted can do control-plane BYO keys but not HSM-backed tenant isolation.

marta (sales): Customer prefers hosted; may accept Dedicated if cost delta small. Need a short doc for procurement comparing options.

sam (billing): Ballpark for 2-week Dedicated trial: reserved capacity pro-rata + BYO-KMS integration fee. Cross-region egress eu->us ~ $0.09/GB plus routing surcharge. I'll produce a PDF estimate tonight.

elaine (legal): We can provide EU subprocessor list but require NDA before full attestation. BYO-KMS requires DPA addendum.

kevin (infra): Recommend routing policy: primary eu-west-1, failover us-west-2, sticky_ttl 300s. For POC we'll disable cross-region cache warming to limit egress.

raj (solutions): I'll prepare a one-pager with pinning constraints, cost delta, timeline, and legal prerequisites. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

marta (sales): Procurement contact: procurement@northstarhealth.example. If Dedicated+BYO pushes >25% they need exec OK.

ops-bot: Ticket created: POC-1765001234-DedicatedTrial. Owners: @kevin, @raj. ETA setup: 3 business days.

kevin (infra): I'll confirm node POPs (eu-west-1a/b) and provide colo list after ops ticket.

sam (billing): Will attach line items: 2-week reserved slot, BYO-KMS fee, egress estimate, support SLA uplift.
